items.question: Trong câu "An orchestrator turns a fleet of machines into one pool of compute and keeps your containers running according to a description you provide.", từ "fleet" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An orchestrator turns a fleet of machines into one pool of compute and keeps your containers running according to a description you provide.", what does "fleet" (noun) mean?
options: hạm đội tàu chiến trên biển
tập hợp nhiều máy cùng loại
hàng đợi các công việc chờ
bản sao dự phòng của máy
optionsEn: a group of warships at sea
a group of machines run together
a backup copy of a machine
items.explanation: fleet /fliːt/ (danh từ): tập hợp nhiều máy cùng loại. "A fleet of servers/vehicles" = một đội máy chủ/xe được quản lý chung; orchestrator gộp cả đội máy thành một khối tài nguyên.
items.explanationEn: fleet /fliːt/ (noun): a group of machines run together. "A fleet of servers" or "a fleet of vehicles" is a set managed as one; the orchestrator pools the whole fleet.

items.question: Trong câu "Production asks more: run 40 copies across 12 machines, restart crashed ones, move them off a dead server, roll out versions without downtime, give them stable addresses and inject config.", từ "inject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Production asks more: run 40 copies across 12 machines, restart crashed ones, move them off a dead server, roll out versions without downtime, give them stable addresses and inject config.", what does "inject" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give a drug by needle
items.explanation: inject /ɪnˈdʒekt/ (động từ): đưa vào, nạp vào. "Inject config/dependencies" = đưa cấu hình hoặc phụ thuộc vào ứng dụng từ bên ngoài thay vì viết cứng trong code.
items.explanationEn: inject /ɪnˈdʒekt/ (verb): to insert or supply into. "Inject config" or "dependency injection" means supplying something from outside instead of hard-coding it.

items.question: Trong câu "Production asks more: run 40 copies across 12 machines, restart crashed ones, move them off a dead server, roll out versions without downtime, give them stable addresses and inject config.", từ "downtime" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Production asks more: run 40 copies across 12 machines, restart crashed ones, move them off a dead server, roll out versions without downtime, give them stable addresses and inject config.", what does "downtime" (noun) mean?
options: thời gian nghỉ ngơi thư giãn
thời gian phản hồi yêu cầu
thời gian cài đặt ban đầu
items.explanation: downtime /ˈdaʊntaɪm/ (danh từ): thời gian ngừng hoạt động. "Without downtime" / "zero downtime" = không làm gián đoạn dịch vụ khi triển khai phiên bản mới.
items.explanationEn: downtime /ˈdaʊntaɪm/ (noun): time a system is unavailable. "Without downtime" or "zero-downtime deployment" means users never lose the service during a release.

items.question: Trong câu "Scripts around docker run stop working after a handful of hosts.", từ "handful" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scripts around docker run stop working after a handful of hosts.", what does "handful" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an amount held in one hand
items.explanation: handful /ˈhændfʊl/ (danh từ): một số ít. "A handful of" = một vài, số lượng nhỏ; script thủ công chỉ ổn với vài máy.
items.explanationEn: handful /ˈhændfʊl/ (noun): a small number. "A handful of" means only a few; hand-written scripts only cope with a few hosts.

items.question: Trong câu "An orchestrator turns a fleet of machines into one pool of compute and keeps your containers running according to a description you provide.", từ "according to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An orchestrator turns a fleet of machines into one pool of compute and keeps your containers running according to a description you provide.", what does "according to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: according to /əˈkɔːdɪŋ tuː/ (cụm từ): theo, dựa theo. "According to the spec/plan" = làm đúng theo bản mô tả; Kubernetes chạy container theo mô tả bạn cung cấp.
items.explanationEn: according to /əˈkɔːdɪŋ tuː/ (phrase): in line with. "According to a description" means following it; Kubernetes runs containers in line with what you describe.

items.question: Trong câu "Kubernetes (K8s) grew out of Google's Borg, was open-sourced in 2014 and is governed by the CNCF.", từ "govern" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kubernetes (K8s) grew out of Google's Borg, was open-sourced in 2014 and is governed by the CNCF.", what does "govern" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: govern /ˈɡʌvn/ (động từ): quản lý, điều hành. "Be governed by" = do một tổ chức quản lý, đặt quy tắc; danh từ "governance" = sự quản trị.
items.explanationEn: govern /ˈɡʌvn/ (verb): to control and manage. "Be governed by" means an organisation controls and sets the rules; the noun is "governance".

items.question: Trong câu "Kubernetes (K8s) grew out of Google's Borg, was open-sourced in 2014 and is governed by the CNCF.", từ "grow out of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kubernetes (K8s) grew out of Google's Borg, was open-sourced in 2014 and is governed by the CNCF.", what does "grow out of" (phrase) mean?
options: phát triển từ, bắt nguồn từ
items.explanation: grow out of /ɡrəʊ aʊt ɒv/ (cụm từ): phát triển từ, bắt nguồn từ. "X grew out of Y" = X hình thành từ Y; nghĩa khác "grow out of clothes" = lớn đến mức quần áo không vừa.
items.explanationEn: grow out of /ɡrəʊ aʊt ɒv/ (phrase): to develop from. "X grew out of Y" means X developed from Y; "grow out of clothes" is the other sense.

items.question: Trong câu "A cluster has a control plane (stores desired state, makes decisions) and worker nodes (run Pods).", từ "desired" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A cluster has a control plane (stores desired state, makes decisions) and worker nodes (run Pods).", what does "desired" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: desired /dɪˈzaɪəd/ (tính từ): mong muốn. "Desired state" = trạng thái mong muốn, đối lập với "actual/observed state" = trạng thái thực tế.
items.explanationEn: desired /dɪˈzaɪəd/ (adjective): wanted. "Desired state" is what you want, as opposed to the "actual" or "observed" state.

items.question: Trong câu "Components coordinate through the API server, not by calling each other: the scheduler writes a node name onto the Pod, and that node's kubelet notices through a watch.", từ "coordinate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Components coordinate through the API server, not by calling each other: the scheduler writes a node name onto the Pod, and that node's kubelet notices through a watch.", what does "coordinate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: coordinate /kəʊˈɔːdɪneɪt/ (động từ): phối hợp với nhau. "Coordinate through X" = phối hợp thông qua X; các thành phần không gọi nhau trực tiếp mà đi qua API server.
items.explanationEn: coordinate /kəʊˈɔːdɪneɪt/ (verb): to work together. "Coordinate through X" means organising work via X; components never call each other directly.

items.question: Trong câu "Also, dockershim was removed in v1.24 (2022), so nodes no longer use Docker Engine — but Docker-built images are standard OCI images and run unchanged.", từ "unchanged" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also, dockershim was removed in v1.24 (2022), so nodes no longer use Docker Engine — but Docker-built images are standard OCI images and run unchanged.", what does "unchanged" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unchanged /ʌnˈtʃeɪndʒd/ (tính từ): không cần thay đổi. "Run unchanged" = chạy y nguyên, không phải sửa gì; hay gặp trong "remain unchanged" = giữ nguyên.
items.explanationEn: unchanged /ʌnˈtʃeɪndʒd/ (adjective): without any modification. "Run unchanged" means no modification is needed; also common in "remain unchanged".

items.question: Trong câu "and controllers continuously compare spec (desired) with status (observed) and fix the difference — the reconciliation loop.", từ "continuously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and controllers continuously compare spec (desired) with status (observed) and fix the difference — the reconciliation loop.", what does "continuously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: continuously /kənˈtɪnjuəsli/ (trạng từ): liên tục. "Continuously compare/monitor" = so sánh, theo dõi không ngừng; xem thêm "continuous integration".
items.explanationEn: continuously /kənˈtɪnjuəsli/ (adverb): without stopping. "Continuously compare" means doing it without a break; compare "continuous integration".

items.question: Trong câu "and controllers continuously compare spec (desired) with status (observed) and fix the difference — the reconciliation loop.", từ "reconciliation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and controllers continuously compare spec (desired) with status (observed) and fix the difference — the reconciliation loop.", what does "reconciliation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reconciliation /ˌrekənsɪliˈeɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự điều chỉnh cho khớp. "Reconciliation loop" = vòng lặp đưa trạng thái thực tế về khớp với trạng thái mong muốn; nghĩa đời thường là sự hòa giải.
items.explanationEn: reconciliation /ˌrekənsɪliˈeɪʃn/ (noun): bringing two states into agreement. A "reconciliation loop" keeps making actual state match desired state; in daily life it means making peace.

items.question: Trong câu "kubectl create -f is imperative (fails if the object exists); kubectl apply -f is declarative and idempotent — the production way, with YAML reviewed in Git (GitOps, topic 14).", từ "imperative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "kubectl create -f is imperative (fails if the object exists); kubectl apply -f is declarative and idempotent — the production way, with YAML reviewed in Git (GitOps, topic 14).", what does "imperative" (adjective) mean?
options: theo kiểu mô tả kết quả
theo kiểu ra lệnh từng bước
items.explanation: imperative /ɪmˈperətɪv/ (tính từ): theo kiểu ra lệnh từng bước. "Imperative vs declarative" = ra lệnh từng bước vs mô tả kết quả; "It is imperative that..." lại mang nghĩa cấp thiết.
items.explanationEn: imperative /ɪmˈperətɪv/ (adjective): giving step-by-step commands. "Imperative vs declarative" contrasts commands with descriptions; "it is imperative that" means it is urgent.

items.question: Trong câu "kubectl create -f is imperative (fails if the object exists); kubectl apply -f is declarative and idempotent — the production way, with YAML reviewed in Git (GitOps, topic 14).", từ "idempotent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "kubectl create -f is imperative (fails if the object exists); kubectl apply -f is declarative and idempotent — the production way, with YAML reviewed in Git (GitOps, topic 14).", what does "idempotent" (adjective) mean?
options: chạy nhiều lần vẫn cùng kết quả
chỉ được chạy một lần duy nhất
optionsEn: giving the same result if repeated
items.explanation: idempotent /ˌaɪdemˈpəʊtənt/ (tính từ): chạy nhiều lần vẫn cùng kết quả. "Idempotent operation" = thao tác lặp lại bao nhiêu lần cũng cho cùng kết quả; ví dụ HTTP PUT, kubectl apply.
items.explanationEn: idempotent /ˌaɪdemˈpəʊtənt/ (adjective): giving the same result if repeated. An "idempotent operation" can be repeated safely with the same outcome, like HTTP PUT or kubectl apply.

items.question: Trong câu "A manual kubectl scale is silently reverted by the next apply from Git, which is exactly the point.", từ "revert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A manual kubectl scale is silently reverted by the next apply from Git, which is exactly the point.", what does "revert" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to upgrade to a new version
to return to a previous state
items.explanation: revert /rɪˈvɜːt/ (động từ): đưa về trạng thái cũ. "Revert a change/commit" = hoàn tác, đưa về như trước; "revert to" = quay lại trạng thái cũ.
items.explanationEn: revert /rɪˈvɜːt/ (verb): to return to a previous state. "Revert a commit" means undoing it; "revert to" means going back to an earlier state.

items.question: Trong câu "A manual kubectl scale is silently reverted by the next apply from Git, which is exactly the point.", từ "silently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A manual kubectl scale is silently reverted by the next apply from Git, which is exactly the point.", what does "silently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (trạng từ): không báo hiệu gì. "Fail/be ignored silently" = xảy ra mà không có cảnh báo hay lỗi nào; hay gặp khi nói về bug khó phát hiện.
items.explanationEn: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (adverb): without any notice. "Fail silently" means it happens with no warning or error, which makes bugs hard to spot.

items.question: Trong câu "A Pod is one or more containers scheduled together on one node, sharing one network namespace (one IP, reachable to each other on localhost) and the Pod's volumes.", từ "schedule" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Pod is one or more containers scheduled together on one node, sharing one network namespace (one IP, reachable to each other on localhost) and the Pod's volumes.", what does "schedule" (verb) mean?
options: phân bổ để chạy ở một nơi
optionsEn: to assign to run in a place
items.explanation: schedule /ˈʃedjuːl/ (động từ): phân bổ để chạy ở một nơi. "Be scheduled on a node" = được xếp đặt chạy trên một node; ngoài đời "schedule a meeting" = lên lịch họp.
items.explanationEn: schedule /ˈʃedjuːl/ (verb): to assign to run in a place. "Scheduled on a node" means placed there to run; in daily life "schedule a meeting" means plan its time.

items.question: Trong câu "A Pod is one or more containers scheduled together on one node, sharing one network namespace (one IP, reachable to each other on localhost) and the Pod's volumes.", từ "reachable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Pod is one or more containers scheduled together on one node, sharing one network namespace (one IP, reachable to each other on localhost) and the Pod's volumes.", what does "reachable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (tính từ): có thể kết nối tới. "Reachable from/on" = có thể truy cập tới qua mạng; ngược lại là "unreachable".
items.explanationEn: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (adjective): able to be contacted. "Reachable from" means it can be contacted over the network; the opposite is "unreachable".

items.question: Trong câu "Multi-container Pods are for tightly coupled helpers: log shippers, proxy sidecars, and initContainers that run before the app starts.", từ "tightly coupled" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multi-container Pods are for tightly coupled helpers: log shippers, proxy sidecars, and initContainers that run before the app starts.", what does "tightly coupled" (phrase) mean?
options: gắn kết chặt chẽ với nhau
hoạt động hoàn toàn độc lập
items.explanation: tightly coupled /ˈtaɪtli ˈkʌpld/ (cụm từ): gắn kết chặt chẽ với nhau. "Tightly coupled" = phụ thuộc chặt vào nhau; đối lập với "loosely coupled" = liên kết lỏng.
items.explanationEn: tightly coupled /ˈtaɪtli ˈkʌpld/ (phrase): closely dependent on each other. "Tightly coupled" parts depend heavily on each other; the opposite is "loosely coupled".

items.question: Trong câu "Your app and its database do not share a Pod — they scale and fail independently.", từ "independently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your app and its database do not share a Pod — they scale and fail independently.", what does "independently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: independently /ˌɪndɪˈpendəntli/ (trạng từ): một cách độc lập. "Scale independently" = mở rộng riêng rẽ, không kéo theo thành phần khác; "independently of" = không phụ thuộc vào.
items.explanationEn: independently /ˌɪndɪˈpendəntli/ (adverb): separately, on their own. "Scale independently" means each part grows on its own; "independently of" means not relying on.

items.question: Trong câu "The key property: Pods are ephemeral.", từ "property" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key property: Pods are ephemeral.", what does "property" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: property /ˈprɒpəti/ (danh từ): đặc tính. "Key property" = đặc tính cốt lõi; nghĩa khác "property" = tài sản, nhà đất.
items.explanationEn: property /ˈprɒpəti/ (noun): a characteristic. "Key property" means a defining characteristic; "property" can also mean land or buildings.

items.question: Trong câu "The key property: Pods are ephemeral.", từ "ephemeral" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key property: Pods are ephemeral.", what does "ephemeral" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ephemeral /ɪˈfemərəl/ (tính từ): tồn tại ngắn, tạm thời. "Ephemeral storage/ports" = lưu trữ hoặc cổng tạm thời, mất đi khi tiến trình kết thúc.
items.explanationEn: ephemeral /ɪˈfemərəl/ (adjective): short-lived, temporary. "Ephemeral storage" or "ephemeral ports" last only as long as the process that uses them.

items.question: Trong câu "Never hard-code Pod IPs, and don't create bare Pods — let a controller manage them.", từ "bare" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Never hard-code Pod IPs, and don't create bare Pods — let a controller manage them.", what does "bare" (adjective) mean?
options: đứng riêng, không ai quản lý
items.explanation: bare /beə/ (tính từ): đứng riêng, không ai quản lý. "Bare Pod / bare metal" = chỉ có phần cốt lõi, không có lớp quản lý bao ngoài; nghĩa gốc là trần, trơ trụi.
items.explanationEn: bare /beə/ (adjective): standalone, with nothing managing it. "Bare Pod" or "bare metal" means the core alone, with no managing layer; literally it means naked.

items.question: Trong câu "Labels are key-value tags on objects (app: web, tier: frontend); selectors query them.", từ "query" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Labels are key-value tags on objects (app: web, tier: frontend); selectors query them.", what does "query" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: query /ˈkwɪəri/ (động từ): tra cứu theo điều kiện. "Query a database/API" = truy vấn dữ liệu; nghĩa khác "query a decision" = chất vấn, nghi ngờ.
items.explanationEn: query /ˈkwɪəri/ (verb): to search by conditions. "Query a database" means asking it for matching data; "query a decision" means questioning it.

items.question: Trong câu "This loose coupling is how objects find each other", từ "loose coupling" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This loose coupling is how objects find each other", what does "loose coupling" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: loose coupling /luːs ˈkʌplɪŋ/ (cụm từ): sự liên kết lỏng lẻo. "Loose coupling" = các thành phần biết rất ít về nhau nên dễ thay đổi riêng; là nguyên tắc thiết kế quan trọng.
items.explanationEn: loose coupling /luːs ˈkʌplɪŋ/ (phrase): a weak link between parts. "Loose coupling" means parts know little about each other, so each can change freely.

items.question: Trong câu "A ReplicaSet keeps N identical Pods running from a template", từ "identical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A ReplicaSet keeps N identical Pods running from a template", what does "identical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: identical /aɪˈdentɪkl/ (tính từ): giống hệt nhau. "Identical to" = giống hệt; các bản sao Pod đều được tạo từ cùng một template.
items.explanationEn: identical /aɪˈdentɪkl/ (adjective): exactly the same. "Identical to" means exactly alike; all replicas come from the same template.

items.question: Trong câu "Consequences: delete a Pod and a replacement appears at once; remove the label from a Pod (kubectl label pod web-abc app-) and it is orphaned — a new one is created while the old Pod stays alive for debugging.", từ "at once" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consequences: delete a Pod and a replacement appears at once; remove the label from a Pod (kubectl label pod web-abc app-) and it is orphaned — a new one is created while the old Pod stays alive for debugging.", what does "at once" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at once /ət wʌns/ (cụm từ): ngay lập tức. "At once" ở đây = ngay lập tức; nghĩa khác "all at once" = cùng một lúc.
items.explanationEn: at once /ət wʌns/ (phrase): immediately. Here "at once" means immediately; in "all at once" it means simultaneously.

items.question: Trong câu "Consequences: delete a Pod and a replacement appears at once; remove the label from a Pod (kubectl label pod web-abc app-) and it is orphaned — a new one is created while the old Pod stays alive for debugging.", từ "orphan" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consequences: delete a Pod and a replacement appears at once; remove the label from a Pod (kubectl label pod web-abc app-) and it is orphaned — a new one is created while the old Pod stays alive for debugging.", what does "orphan" (verb) mean?
options: bỏ lại không còn ai quản lý
items.explanation: orphan /ˈɔːfn/ (động từ): bỏ lại không còn ai quản lý. "Be orphaned" = bị mất đối tượng cha quản lý nhưng vẫn tồn tại; "orphaned resources" hay gây tốn phí.
items.explanationEn: orphan /ˈɔːfn/ (verb): to leave without an owner. "Be orphaned" means losing the parent that managed it while still existing; orphaned resources waste money.

items.question: Trong câu "A Deployment manages ReplicaSets for stateless apps.", từ "stateless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Deployment manages ReplicaSets for stateless apps.", what does "stateless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stateless /ˈsteɪtləs/ (tính từ): không lưu trạng thái. "Stateless app" = ứng dụng không giữ dữ liệu riêng giữa các request nên dễ thay thế; đối lập "stateful".
items.explanationEn: stateless /ˈsteɪtləs/ (adjective): keeping no stored state. A "stateless app" keeps no data between requests, so any copy can serve; the opposite is "stateful".

items.question: Trong câu "Change the Pod template (e.g. the image tag) and it creates a new ReplicaSet, shifting Pods over gradually.", từ "gradually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Change the Pod template (e.g. the image tag) and it creates a new ReplicaSet, shifting Pods over gradually.", what does "gradually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: gradually /ˈɡrædʒuəli/ (trạng từ): dần dần, từng bước. "Gradually shift/roll out" = chuyển dần từng phần; là bản chất của rolling update.
items.explanationEn: gradually /ˈɡrædʒuəli/ (adverb): step by step. "Gradually roll out" means moving a little at a time, which is what a rolling update does.

items.question: Trong câu "Only changes to spec.template trigger a rollout; spec.selector is immutable.", từ "trigger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only changes to spec.template trigger a rollout; spec.selector is immutable.", what does "trigger" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə/ (động từ): kích hoạt. "Trigger a build/rollout" = làm khởi động một quá trình; danh từ "trigger" = cò súng, yếu tố kích hoạt.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə/ (verb): to set off. "Trigger a rollout" means start it; the noun "trigger" is what sets something off.

items.question: Trong câu "Only changes to spec.template trigger a rollout; spec.selector is immutable.", từ "immutable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only changes to spec.template trigger a rollout; spec.selector is immutable.", what does "immutable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immutable /ɪˈmjuːtəbl/ (tính từ): không thể thay đổi. "Immutable field/infrastructure" = không sửa được sau khi tạo, muốn đổi phải tạo mới; ngược lại "mutable".
items.explanationEn: immutable /ɪˈmjuːtəbl/ (adjective): unable to be changed. An "immutable field" cannot be edited after creation, so you must recreate it; the opposite is "mutable".

items.question: Trong câu "A Service gives the Pods matching a selector a stable virtual IP and DNS name, and spreads connections across the ones that are ready.", từ "virtual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Service gives the Pods matching a selector a stable virtual IP and DNS name, and spreads connections across the ones that are ready.", what does "virtual" (adjective) mean?
options: ảo, không gắn với máy thật
optionsEn: not tied to a real device
items.explanation: virtual /ˈvɜːtʃuəl/ (tính từ): ảo, không gắn với máy thật. "Virtual IP" = IP ảo không thuộc card mạng nào; nghĩa khác "virtually" = gần như.
items.explanationEn: virtual /ˈvɜːtʃuəl/ (adjective): not tied to a real device. A "virtual IP" belongs to no real network card; "virtually" can also mean almost.

items.question: Trong câu "A Service gives the Pods matching a selector a stable virtual IP and DNS name, and spreads connections across the ones that are ready.", từ "spread" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Service gives the Pods matching a selector a stable virtual IP and DNS name, and spreads connections across the ones that are ready.", what does "spread" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cover with a thin layer
items.explanation: spread /spred/ (động từ): phân tán, rải đều ra. "Spread load/traffic across" = rải tải ra nhiều máy; nghĩa khác "spread butter" = phết bơ.
items.explanationEn: spread /spred/ (verb): to distribute across. "Spread traffic across" means distributing it; "spread butter" is the other sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Long-lived HTTP/2 or gRPC connections stick to one Pod — a classic cause of uneven load.", từ "stick to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Long-lived HTTP/2 or gRPC connections stick to one Pod — a classic cause of uneven load.", what does "stick to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: stick to /stɪk tuː/ (cụm từ): bám cố định vào. "Stick to one Pod" = dính chặt vào một Pod; nghĩa khác "stick to the plan" = bám theo kế hoạch.
items.explanationEn: stick to /stɪk tuː/ (phrase): to stay attached to. "Stick to one Pod" means staying attached to it; "stick to the plan" means keep following it.

items.question: Trong câu "Long-lived HTTP/2 or gRPC connections stick to one Pod — a classic cause of uneven load.", từ "classic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Long-lived HTTP/2 or gRPC connections stick to one Pod — a classic cause of uneven load.", what does "classic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæsɪk/ (tính từ): điển hình, thường gặp. "A classic mistake/cause" = lỗi, nguyên nhân kinh điển mà ai cũng hay gặp.
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæsɪk/ (adjective): typical and well known. "A classic mistake" or "a classic cause" is a typical, well-known one.

items.question: Trong câu "Long-lived HTTP/2 or gRPC connections stick to one Pod — a classic cause of uneven load.", từ "uneven" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Long-lived HTTP/2 or gRPC connections stick to one Pod — a classic cause of uneven load.", what does "uneven" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: uneven /ʌnˈiːvn/ (tính từ): không đồng đều. "Uneven load/distribution" = tải phân bổ không đều; nghĩa khác "uneven surface" = bề mặt gồ ghề.
items.explanationEn: uneven /ʌnˈiːvn/ (adjective): not equally shared. "Uneven load" means some servers get more than others; "uneven surface" is the other sense.

items.question: Trong câu "The types stack: a NodePort Service also has a ClusterIP; a LoadBalancer Service (classic implementation) also has a NodePort.", từ "stack" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The types stack: a NodePort Service also has a ClusterIP; a LoadBalancer Service (classic implementation) also has a NodePort.", what does "stack" (verb) mean?
options: xếp chồng, lớp sau bao lớp trước
optionsEn: to build on top of each other
items.explanation: stack /stæk/ (động từ): xếp chồng, lớp sau bao lớp trước. "The types stack" = các loại chồng lên nhau, loại sau bao gồm loại trước; "stack up" = xếp chồng.
items.explanationEn: stack /stæk/ (verb): to build on top of each other. "The types stack" means each one builds on the one below; "stack up" means pile up.

items.question: Trong câu "The types stack: a NodePort Service also has a ClusterIP; a LoadBalancer Service (classic implementation) also has a NodePort.", từ "implementation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The types stack: a NodePort Service also has a ClusterIP; a LoadBalancer Service (classic implementation) also has a NodePort.", what does "implementation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a concrete way of building it
items.explanation: implementation /ˌɪmplɪmenˈteɪʃn/ (danh từ): cách triển khai cụ thể. "Implementation" = cách hiện thực hóa một thiết kế; một đặc tả có thể có nhiều implementation khác nhau.
items.explanationEn: implementation /ˌɪmplɪmenˈteɪʃn/ (noun): a concrete way of building it. An "implementation" is a concrete realisation of a design; one spec can have many implementations.

items.question: Trong câu "Twenty microservices as LoadBalancer means twenty load balancers on the bill; that is why Ingress exists.", từ "bill" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Twenty microservices as LoadBalancer means twenty load balancers on the bill; that is why Ingress exists.", what does "bill" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bill /bɪl/ (danh từ): hóa đơn. "On the bill" = xuất hiện trong hóa đơn phải trả; nghĩa khác "bill" = dự luật trình quốc hội.
items.explanationEn: bill /bɪl/ (noun): a statement of charges. "On the bill" means it shows up as a charge; a "bill" can also be a proposed law.

items.question: Trong câu "An Ingress holds L7 HTTP(S) rules — host and path to Service — so many Services share one entry point and TLS certificate.", từ "entry point" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An Ingress holds L7 HTTP(S) rules — host and path to Service — so many Services share one entry point and TLS certificate.", what does "entry point" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a place where a path ends
a place where traffic comes in
items.explanation: entry point /ˈentri pɔɪnt/ (cụm từ): điểm vào. "Single entry point" = một cổng vào duy nhất cho toàn bộ traffic; trong code còn chỉ nơi chương trình bắt đầu chạy.
items.explanationEn: entry point /ˈentri pɔɪnt/ (phrase): a place where traffic comes in. "Single entry point" is one door for all traffic; in code it is where the program starts.

items.question: Trong câu "An Ingress object does nothing by itself.", từ "by itself" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An Ingress object does nothing by itself.", what does "by itself" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by itself /baɪ ɪtˈself/ (cụm từ): tự nó, một mình nó. "Do nothing by itself" = tự bản thân không làm gì, cần thành phần khác (ingress controller) mới hoạt động.
items.explanationEn: by itself /baɪ ɪtˈself/ (phrase): on its own. "Does nothing by itself" means it needs something else, here an ingress controller, to work.

items.question: Trong câu "An ingress controller — proxy Pods, or an operator driving a cloud LB — watches Ingresses and implements them.", từ "drive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An ingress controller — proxy Pods, or an operator driving a cloud LB — watches Ingresses and implements them.", what does "drive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drive /draɪv/ (động từ): điều khiển, vận hành. "Drive a load balancer / a device" = điều khiển nó hoạt động; từ đó có "driver" = trình điều khiển.
items.explanationEn: drive /draɪv/ (verb): to control and operate. "Driving a load balancer" means controlling it; the same idea gives us "device driver".

items.question: Trong câu "Common controllers: ingress-nginx (NGINX Pods behind one LoadBalancer Service; its retirement was announced in late 2025), the AWS Load Balancer Controller (provisions an ALB), Traefik, HAProxy and Kong.", từ "retirement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Common controllers: ingress-nginx (NGINX Pods behind one LoadBalancer Service; its retirement was announced in late 2025), the AWS Load Balancer Controller (provisions an ALB), Traefik, HAProxy and Kong.", what does "retirement" (noun) mean?
options: sự ngừng phát triển, khai tử
items.explanation: retirement /rɪˈtaɪəmənt/ (danh từ): sự ngừng phát triển, khai tử. "Retirement of a product" = ngừng phát triển, hỗ trợ; động từ "retire a service"; nghĩa gốc là nghỉ hưu.
items.explanationEn: retirement /rɪˈtaɪəmənt/ (noun): being phased out of use. "Retirement of a product" means it is being phased out; "retire a service"; literally stopping work in old age.

items.question: Trong câu "Common controllers: ingress-nginx (NGINX Pods behind one LoadBalancer Service; its retirement was announced in late 2025), the AWS Load Balancer Controller (provisions an ALB), Traefik, HAProxy and Kong.", từ "provision" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Common controllers: ingress-nginx (NGINX Pods behind one LoadBalancer Service; its retirement was announced in late 2025), the AWS Load Balancer Controller (provisions an ALB), Traefik, HAProxy and Kong.", what does "provision" (verb) mean?
options: tạo và cấp phát tài nguyên
optionsEn: to set up and supply resources
items.explanation: provision /prəˈvɪʒn/ (động từ): tạo và cấp phát tài nguyên. "Provision an instance/load balancer" = tạo và cấp sẵn tài nguyên để dùng; danh từ "provisioning".
items.explanationEn: provision /prəˈvɪʒn/ (verb): to set up and supply resources. "Provision a load balancer" means create and supply it ready for use; the noun is "provisioning".

items.question: Trong câu "Anything beyond host/path (rewrites, auth, rate limits) is a controller-specific annotation — not portable.", từ "annotation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Anything beyond host/path (rewrites, auth, rate limits) is a controller-specific annotation — not portable.", what does "annotation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: annotation /ˌænəˈteɪʃn/ (danh từ): ghi chú gắn kèm. "Add an annotation" = thêm ghi chú/metadata gắn vào đối tượng; động từ "annotate".
items.explanationEn: annotation /ˌænəˈteɪʃn/ (noun): an attached note. "Add an annotation" means attach a note or metadata to something; the verb is "annotate".

items.question: Trong câu "Anything beyond host/path (rewrites, auth, rate limits) is a controller-specific annotation — not portable.", từ "portable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Anything beyond host/path (rewrites, auth, rate limits) is a controller-specific annotation — not portable.", what does "portable" (adjective) mean?
options: dùng được trên nhiều nền tảng
items.explanation: portable /ˈpɔːtəbl/ (tính từ): dùng được trên nhiều nền tảng. "Portable config/code" = chuyển sang môi trường khác vẫn chạy; nghĩa khác "portable speaker" = loa xách tay.
items.explanationEn: portable /ˈpɔːtəbl/ (adjective): usable across platforms. "Portable code" moves between environments unchanged; "portable speaker" is the carry-around sense.

items.question: Trong câu "The Gateway API (Gateway, HTTPRoute; GA 2023) is the successor with role separation and richer, portable routing.", từ "successor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Gateway API (Gateway, HTTPRoute; GA 2023) is the successor with role separation and richer, portable routing.", what does "successor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: successor /səkˈsesə/ (danh từ): cái kế nhiệm. "The successor to X" = thứ thay thế X về sau; đối lập "predecessor" = người/cái đi trước.
items.explanationEn: successor /səkˈsesə/ (noun): the one that comes next. "The successor to X" replaces X later; the opposite is "predecessor".

items.question: Trong câu "The Gateway API (Gateway, HTTPRoute; GA 2023) is the successor with role separation and richer, portable routing.", từ "rich" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Gateway API (Gateway, HTTPRoute; GA 2023) is the successor with role separation and richer, portable routing.", what does "rich" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: rich /rɪtʃ/ (tính từ): phong phú, nhiều tính năng. "Richer routing / rich text" = định tuyến nhiều khả năng hơn, văn bản nhiều định dạng; nghĩa gốc là giàu.
items.explanationEn: rich /rɪtʃ/ (adjective): full of features. "Richer routing" or "rich text" means more capable; the everyday sense is wealthy.

items.question: Trong câu "Following 12-factor, config lives outside the image.", từ "following" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Following 12-factor, config lives outside the image.", what does "following" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: following /ˈfɒləʊɪŋ/ (giới từ): theo, tuân theo. "Following X" ở đây = làm theo nguyên tắc X; nghĩa khác "following the meeting" = sau cuộc họp.
items.explanationEn: following /ˈfɒləʊɪŋ/ (preposition): in accordance with. Here "following X" means in accordance with X; "following the meeting" means after it.

items.question: Trong câu "ConfigMap — non-sensitive keys or files (flags, nginx.conf); max 1 MiB.", từ "sensitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ConfigMap — non-sensitive keys or files (flags, nginx.conf); max 1 MiB.", what does "sensitive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sensitive /ˈsensətɪv/ (tính từ): nhạy cảm, cần bảo mật. "Sensitive data" = dữ liệu cần bảo vệ như mật khẩu; "case-sensitive" = phân biệt hoa thường.
items.explanationEn: sensitive /ˈsensətɪv/ (adjective): needing protection. "Sensitive data" must be protected, like passwords; "case-sensitive" means upper and lower case differ.

items.question: Trong câu "Secrets are base64-encoded, not encrypted.", từ "encrypt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Secrets are base64-encoded, not encrypted.", what does "encrypt" (verb) mean?
options: mã hóa bằng khóa bí mật
optionsEn: to compress to a smaller size
to scramble with a secret key
items.explanation: encrypt /ɪnˈkrɪpt/ (động từ): mã hóa bằng khóa bí mật. "Encrypt" cần khóa để giải mã, còn "encode" (như base64) ai cũng đảo ngược được.
items.explanationEn: encrypt /ɪnˈkrɪpt/ (verb): to scramble with a secret key. "Encrypt" needs a key to reverse, whereas "encode" (like base64) can be reversed by anyone.

items.question: Trong câu "Baseline: encryption at rest for etcd, RBAC limits on Secrets (topic 7), no Secret YAML in Git, and ideally an external store (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault) synced by External Secrets Operator or the Secrets Store CSI Driver.", từ "baseline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Baseline: encryption at rest for etcd, RBAC limits on Secrets (topic 7), no Secret YAML in Git, and ideally an external store (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault) synced by External Secrets Operator or the Secrets Store CSI Driver.", what does "baseline" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the back line of a court
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪslaɪn/ (danh từ): mức tối thiểu cần có. "Security baseline" = mức bảo mật tối thiểu phải đạt; "baseline" cũng là mốc gốc để so sánh.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪslaɪn/ (noun): the minimum standard. A "security baseline" is the minimum you must meet; a baseline is also a reference point for comparison.

items.question: Trong câu "Baseline: encryption at rest for etcd, RBAC limits on Secrets (topic 7), no Secret YAML in Git, and ideally an external store (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault) synced by External Secrets Operator or the Secrets Store CSI Driver.", từ "at rest" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Baseline: encryption at rest for etcd, RBAC limits on Secrets (topic 7), no Secret YAML in Git, and ideally an external store (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault) synced by External Secrets Operator or the Secrets Store CSI Driver.", what does "at rest" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at rest /ət rest/ (cụm từ): khi đang được lưu trữ. "Encryption at rest" = mã hóa dữ liệu nằm trên đĩa; đối lập "in transit" = dữ liệu đang truyền.
items.explanationEn: at rest /ət rest/ (phrase): while stored. "Encryption at rest" protects stored data; the counterpart is "in transit" for data on the move.

items.question: Trong câu "Baseline: encryption at rest for etcd, RBAC limits on Secrets (topic 7), no Secret YAML in Git, and ideally an external store (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault) synced by External Secrets Operator or the Secrets Store CSI Driver.", từ "ideally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Baseline: encryption at rest for etcd, RBAC limits on Secrets (topic 7), no Secret YAML in Git, and ideally an external store (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault) synced by External Secrets Operator or the Secrets Store CSI Driver.", what does "ideally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: ideally /aɪˈdiːəli/ (trạng từ): lý tưởng nhất là. "Ideally, ..." = tốt nhất là nên; dùng để nêu phương án tối ưu nhưng không bắt buộc.
items.explanationEn: ideally /aɪˈdiːəli/ (adverb): in the best case. "Ideally" introduces the best option, one that is recommended but not required.

items.question: Trong câu "A namespace is a virtual partition of a cluster: names are unique within it, and it is the unit for RBAC, ResourceQuota, LimitRange and NetworkPolicy.", từ "partition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A namespace is a virtual partition of a cluster: names are unique within it, and it is the unit for RBAC, ResourceQuota, LimitRange and NetworkPolicy.", what does "partition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: partition /pɑːˈtɪʃn/ (danh từ): phần được chia ra. "Partition of a cluster/disk" = một phần được chia ra; nghĩa khác là tấm vách ngăn phòng.
items.explanationEn: partition /pɑːˈtɪʃn/ (noun): a divided section. "A partition of a disk or cluster" is a divided section; it can also be a thin wall in a room.

items.question: Trong câu "Namespaces are not network isolation by default: Pods talk across them until a NetworkPolicy restricts it, and share nodes.", từ "isolation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Namespaces are not network isolation by default: Pods talk across them until a NetworkPolicy restricts it, and share nodes.", what does "isolation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: isolation /ˌaɪsəˈleɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự cô lập, tách biệt. "Network isolation" = tách biệt mạng để không liên lạc được; động từ "isolate".
items.explanationEn: isolation /ˌaɪsəˈleɪʃn/ (noun): being kept apart. "Network isolation" keeps workloads from talking to each other; the verb is "isolate".

items.question: Trong câu "Namespaces are not network isolation by default: Pods talk across them until a NetworkPolicy restricts it, and share nodes.", từ "by default" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Namespaces are not network isolation by default: Pods talk across them until a NetworkPolicy restricts it, and share nodes.", what does "by default" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (cụm từ): theo mặc định. "By default" = khi không cấu hình gì thêm; "default value" = giá trị mặc định.
items.explanationEn: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (phrase): unless changed. "By default" describes what happens when you configure nothing; a "default value" is the preset one.

items.question: Trong câu "Namespaces are not network isolation by default: Pods talk across them until a NetworkPolicy restricts it, and share nodes.", từ "restrict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Namespaces are not network isolation by default: Pods talk across them until a NetworkPolicy restricts it, and share nodes.", what does "restrict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: restrict /rɪˈstrɪkt/ (động từ): hạn chế. "Restrict access/traffic" = giới hạn truy cập; danh từ "restriction".
items.explanationEn: restrict /rɪˈstrɪkt/ (verb): to limit. "Restrict access" means limiting it; the noun is "restriction".

items.question: Trong câu "Hostile tenants need separate clusters.", từ "hostile" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hostile tenants need separate clusters.", what does "hostile" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hostile /ˈhɒstaɪl/ (tính từ): có ý đồ xấu. "Hostile tenant/environment" = đối tượng có thể tấn công, không tin được; ngược lại "trusted".
items.explanationEn: hostile /ˈhɒstaɪl/ (adjective): acting with bad intent. A "hostile tenant" may attack others and cannot be trusted; the opposite is "trusted".

items.question: Trong câu "Hostile tenants need separate clusters.", từ "tenant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hostile tenants need separate clusters.", what does "tenant" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tenant /ˈtenənt/ (danh từ): bên dùng chung hệ thống. "Multi-tenant" = nhiều khách hàng dùng chung một hệ thống; nghĩa gốc "tenant" = người thuê nhà.
items.explanationEn: tenant /ˈtenənt/ (noun): a customer sharing a system. "Multi-tenant" means many customers share one system; literally a "tenant" rents a home.

items.question: Trong câu "Prod and non-prod as namespaces in one cluster is cheap but risky — a bad upgrade or noisy neighbour hits production.", từ "noisy neighbour" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prod and non-prod as namespaces in one cluster is cheap but risky — a bad upgrade or noisy neighbour hits production.", what does "noisy neighbour" (phrase) mean?
options: ứng dụng chung máy chiếm tài nguyên
máy chủ dự phòng đặt gần đó
người dùng gửi nhiều khiếu nại
dịch vụ ghi log quá chi tiết
items.explanation: noisy neighbour /ˈnɔɪzi ˈneɪbə/ (cụm từ): ứng dụng chung máy chiếm tài nguyên. "Noisy neighbour problem" = một workload dùng chung hạ tầng chiếm CPU/IO làm chậm các workload khác.
items.explanationEn: noisy neighbour /ˈnɔɪzi ˈneɪbə/ (phrase): a co-located workload hogging resources. The "noisy neighbour problem" is when one workload on shared hardware slows down the others.

items.question: Trong câu "Built-ins: default (objects with no namespace given), kube-system (CoreDNS, kube-proxy, CNI), kube-public and kube-node-lease (node heartbeats).", từ "heartbeat" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Built-ins: default (objects with no namespace given), kube-system (CoreDNS, kube-proxy, CNI), kube-public and kube-node-lease (node heartbeats).", what does "heartbeat" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a signal saying it is alive
items.explanation: heartbeat /ˈhɑːtbiːt/ (danh từ): tín hiệu báo còn sống. "Heartbeat" = tín hiệu gửi định kỳ để báo vẫn hoạt động; mất heartbeat thì node bị coi là chết.
items.explanationEn: heartbeat /ˈhɑːtbiːt/ (noun): a signal saying it is alive. A "heartbeat" is sent regularly to show something is alive; missing heartbeats mark a node as down.

items.question: Trong câu "kubectl is an API client configured by kubeconfig (~/.kube/config): clusters, users and contexts.", từ "context" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "kubectl is an API client configured by kubeconfig (~/.kube/config): clusters, users and contexts.", what does "context" (noun) mean?
options: bộ thiết lập kết nối đã lưu
items.explanation: context /ˈkɒntekst/ (danh từ): bộ thiết lập kết nối đã lưu. "Switch context" = chuyển sang bộ thiết lập cluster/user khác; nghĩa thường "in this context" = trong bối cảnh này.
items.explanationEn: context /ˈkɒntekst/ (noun): a saved connection setting. "Switch context" means changing to another saved cluster and user; "in this context" is the everyday sense.

items.question: Trong câu "No node fits the requested CPU/memory, or an affinity/volume rule fails", từ "fit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No node fits the requested CPU/memory, or an affinity/volume rule fails", what does "fit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fit /fɪt/ (động từ): đáp ứng đủ yêu cầu. "Fit the requirements" = đáp ứng đủ; ngoài đời "fit" = vừa vặn, "keep fit" = giữ dáng.
items.explanationEn: fit /fɪt/ (verb): to meet the requirements. "Fit the requirements" means satisfying them; "keep fit" is the health sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Wrong tag, or private registry without a pull Secret", từ "registry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Wrong tag, or private registry without a pull Secret", what does "registry" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: registry /ˈredʒɪstri/ (danh từ): kho lưu trữ image. "Container registry" = kho chứa image để pull về; nghĩa gốc là sổ/cơ quan đăng ký chính thức.
items.explanationEn: registry /ˈredʒɪstri/ (noun): a store for images. A "container registry" stores images to pull; originally a registry is an official record office.

items.question: Trong câu "Process keeps exiting: bad config, missing env var, dependency down", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Process keeps exiting: bad config, missing env var, dependency down", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (danh từ): thành phần phụ thuộc. "Dependency down" = dịch vụ mà ứng dụng cần (DB, API) đang chết; "depend on" = phụ thuộc vào.
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (noun): a component relied on. "Dependency down" means a service the app needs is unavailable; the verb is "depend on".

items.question: Trong câu "Amazon EKS runs the control plane — API server and etcd across multiple AZs, patched by AWS — for a per-cluster hourly fee ($0.10/hour on standard support).", từ "patch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Amazon EKS runs the control plane — API server and etcd across multiple AZs, patched by AWS — for a per-cluster hourly fee ($0.10/hour on standard support).", what does "patch" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: patch /pætʃ/ (động từ): cập nhật bản vá lỗi. "Patched by AWS" = AWS cài bản vá bảo mật/lỗi; nghĩa gốc là vá quần áo.
items.explanationEn: patch /pætʃ/ (verb): to apply fixes to. "Patched by AWS" means AWS applies the fixes; literally "patch" means mending cloth.

items.question: Trong câu "Amazon EKS runs the control plane — API server and etcd across multiple AZs, patched by AWS — for a per-cluster hourly fee ($0.10/hour on standard support).", từ "fee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Amazon EKS runs the control plane — API server and etcd across multiple AZs, patched by AWS — for a per-cluster hourly fee ($0.10/hour on standard support).", what does "fee" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fee /fiː/ (danh từ): phí dịch vụ. "Hourly/monthly fee" = phí theo giờ/tháng; khác "fine" = tiền phạt.
items.explanationEn: fee /fiː/ (noun): a charge for a service. "Hourly fee" is a charge per hour; do not confuse it with a "fine", which is a penalty.

items.question: Trong câu "You own worker capacity and workloads.", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You own worker capacity and workloads.", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
options: tài nguyên máy chạy sẵn có
optionsEn: number of seats a venue holds
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (danh từ): tài nguyên máy chạy sẵn có. "Worker capacity" = lượng máy/CPU/RAM để chạy workload; "capacity planning" = hoạch định tài nguyên.
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (noun): available computing resources. "Worker capacity" is the compute you run workloads on; "capacity planning" sizes it ahead.

items.question: Trong câu "You own worker capacity and workloads.", từ "workload" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You own worker capacity and workloads.", what does "workload" (noun) mean?
options: khối lượng việc của nhân viên
ứng dụng chạy trên hệ thống
optionsEn: the amount of work a person has
an application running on a system
items.explanation: workload /ˈwɜːkləʊd/ (danh từ): ứng dụng chạy trên hệ thống. "Workloads" trong cloud = các ứng dụng, job chạy trên hạ tầng; nghĩa thường là khối lượng công việc.
items.explanationEn: workload /ˈwɜːkləʊd/ (noun): an application running on a system. In cloud, "workloads" are the apps and jobs you run; in daily life it is the amount of work.

items.question: Trong câu "EKS vs ECS: ECS for AWS-only teams wanting less to operate; EKS for multi-cloud or on-prem portability, the CNCF ecosystem (Helm, Argo CD, operators) or existing Kubernetes skills.", từ "operate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EKS vs ECS: ECS for AWS-only teams wanting less to operate; EKS for multi-cloud or on-prem portability, the CNCF ecosystem (Helm, Argo CD, operators) or existing Kubernetes skills.", what does "operate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: operate /ˈɒpəreɪt/ (động từ): vận hành. "Less to operate" = ít việc vận hành hơn; danh từ "operations" (ops); nghĩa khác "operate on a patient" = phẫu thuật.
items.explanationEn: operate /ˈɒpəreɪt/ (verb): to run and maintain. "Less to operate" means less to run and maintain; "operate on a patient" is the medical sense.

items.question: Trong câu "EKS vs ECS: ECS for AWS-only teams wanting less to operate; EKS for multi-cloud or on-prem portability, the CNCF ecosystem (Helm, Argo CD, operators) or existing Kubernetes skills.", từ "portability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EKS vs ECS: ECS for AWS-only teams wanting less to operate; EKS for multi-cloud or on-prem portability, the CNCF ecosystem (Helm, Argo CD, operators) or existing Kubernetes skills.", what does "portability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: portability /ˌpɔːtəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): khả năng chuyển môi trường. "Portability" = chuyển giữa các cloud/on-prem mà ít phải sửa; tính từ "portable".
items.explanationEn: portability /ˌpɔːtəˈbɪləti/ (noun): ability to move between environments. "Portability" means moving between clouds or on-prem with little change; the adjective is "portable".

items.question: Trong câu "EKS vs ECS: ECS for AWS-only teams wanting less to operate; EKS for multi-cloud or on-prem portability, the CNCF ecosystem (Helm, Argo CD, operators) or existing Kubernetes skills.", từ "ecosystem" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EKS vs ECS: ECS for AWS-only teams wanting less to operate; EKS for multi-cloud or on-prem portability, the CNCF ecosystem (Helm, Argo CD, operators) or existing Kubernetes skills.", what does "ecosystem" (noun) mean?
options: hệ các công cụ đi kèm
items.explanation: ecosystem /ˈiːkəʊsɪstəm/ (danh từ): hệ các công cụ đi kèm. "The CNCF ecosystem" = cộng đồng công cụ, dự án xoay quanh một nền tảng; nghĩa gốc là hệ sinh thái tự nhiên.
items.explanationEn: ecosystem /ˈiːkəʊsɪstəm/ (noun): a community of related tools. "The CNCF ecosystem" is the community of tools around a platform; originally a biological system.

items.question: Trong câu "EKS vs ECS: ECS for AWS-only teams wanting less to operate; EKS for multi-cloud or on-prem portability, the CNCF ecosystem (Helm, Argo CD, operators) or existing Kubernetes skills.", từ "existing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EKS vs ECS: ECS for AWS-only teams wanting less to operate; EKS for multi-cloud or on-prem portability, the CNCF ecosystem (Helm, Argo CD, operators) or existing Kubernetes skills.", what does "existing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: existing /ɪɡˈzɪstɪŋ/ (tính từ): hiện có. "Existing skills/infrastructure" = kỹ năng, hạ tầng đang có sẵn, tận dụng được ngay.
items.explanationEn: existing /ɪɡˈzɪstɪŋ/ (adjective): already present. "Existing skills" are the ones a team already has and can reuse.

items.question: Trong câu "Kubernetes is declarative: desired state goes through the API server into etcd; controllers reconcile toward it forever.", từ "declarative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kubernetes is declarative: desired state goes through the API server into etcd; controllers reconcile toward it forever.", what does "declarative" (adjective) mean?
options: mô tả kết quả mong muốn
items.explanation: declarative /dɪˈklærətɪv/ (tính từ): mô tả kết quả mong muốn. "Declarative" = khai báo kết quả mong muốn, hệ thống tự tìm cách đạt; đối lập "imperative".
items.explanationEn: declarative /dɪˈklærətɪv/ (adjective): describing the wanted result. "Declarative" means stating the outcome and letting the system get there; the opposite is "imperative".

items.question: Trong câu "Kubernetes is declarative: desired state goes through the API server into etcd; controllers reconcile toward it forever.", từ "reconcile" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kubernetes is declarative: desired state goes through the API server into etcd; controllers reconcile toward it forever.", what does "reconcile" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reconcile /ˈrekənsaɪl/ (động từ): điều chỉnh cho khớp. "Reconcile toward desired state" = liên tục chỉnh cho khớp; "reconcile accounts" = đối chiếu sổ sách.
items.explanationEn: reconcile /ˈrekənsaɪl/ (verb): to bring into agreement. "Reconcile toward desired state" means keep correcting until it matches; "reconcile accounts" is the finance sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Labels/selectors wire objects together; a Service without endpoints usually means a selector mismatch or unready Pods.", từ "wire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Labels/selectors wire objects together; a Service without endpoints usually means a selector mismatch or unready Pods.", what does "wire" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: wire /ˈwaɪə/ (động từ): kết nối, liên kết. "Wire things together" = nối các thành phần lại với nhau; nghĩa khác "wire money" = chuyển khoản.
items.explanationEn: wire /ˈwaɪə/ (verb): to connect together. "Wire things together" means connecting components; "wire money" means a bank transfer.

items.question: Trong câu "Labels/selectors wire objects together; a Service without endpoints usually means a selector mismatch or unready Pods.", từ "mismatch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Labels/selectors wire objects together; a Service without endpoints usually means a selector mismatch or unready Pods.", what does "mismatch" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mismatch /ˈmɪsmætʃ/ (danh từ): sự không khớp. "Selector/version mismatch" = hai giá trị lẽ ra phải khớp nhưng không khớp.
items.explanationEn: mismatch /ˈmɪsmætʃ/ (noun): a failure to match. "Selector mismatch" or "version mismatch" means two values that should agree do not.

items.question: Trong câu "Pods are disposable, ReplicaSets keep a count, Deployments add versioned rollouts.", từ "disposable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pods are disposable, ReplicaSets keep a count, Deployments add versioned rollouts.", what does "disposable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: disposable /dɪˈspəʊzəbl/ (tính từ): dùng xong có thể bỏ. "Disposable" = dùng một lần rồi bỏ, thay bằng cái mới; "disposable income" = thu nhập khả dụng.
items.explanationEn: disposable /dɪˈspəʊzəbl/ (adjective): meant to be thrown away. "Disposable" means used and then replaced; "disposable income" is money left after tax.

items.question: Trong câu "Namespaces scope names, RBAC and quotas — not network isolation.", từ "scope" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Namespaces scope names, RBAC and quotas — not network isolation.", what does "scope" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (động từ): giới hạn phạm vi của. "Scope X to Y" = giới hạn X trong phạm vi Y; danh từ "scope" = phạm vi, "cluster-scoped".
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (verb): to limit the range of. "Scope X to Y" means limiting X to Y; the noun gives "cluster-scoped" and "namespace-scoped".
